Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer bot misinterpreted the birth date of Wanderley Oliveira from the search results. It incorrectly identified the birth date as 29 March 1988 based on the Wikipedia summary shown in the search results, which actually referred to Wanderley Oliveira’s participation in the 1988 Olympics, not his birth year. The correct birth date for Wanderley Oliveira appears later in the search results as "16 June 1942," but WebSurfer failed to resolve this ambiguity or cross-verify the candidates and their associated birthdates properly. This led Planner to make an incorrect conclusion that Alexey Volkonsky, born in 1978, was older. Proper disambiguation of results and prioritization of contextually relevant information could have avoided this error.
